mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zw_advice (RECIPIENT_ID, SENDER_ID, ADVICE_TYPE, ADVICE_STATUS, ADVICE_DESC, SENDER_TYPE, CREATE_TIME) VALUES (#{recipientId}, #{senderId}, #{adviceType}, #{adviceStatus}, #{adviceDesc}, #{senderType}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, sr.NAME as SENDER_NAME, rr.NAME as RECIPIENT_NAME, at.CODE_DESC as ADVICE_TYPE_NAME, ast.CODE_DESC as ADVICE_STATUS_NAME, st.CODE_DESC as SENDER_TYPE_NAME, GROUP_CONCAT(i.IMAGE_URL ORDER BY i.CREATE_TIME) as IMAGE_URLS FROM zw_advice a LEFT JOIN g_user sr ON a.SENDER_ID = sr.USER_ID LEFT JOIN g_user rr ON a.RECIPIENT_ID = rr.USER_ID LEFT JOIN g_code at ON a.ADVICE_TYPE = at.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code ast ON a.ADVICE_STATUS = ast.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code st ON a.SENDER_TYPE = st.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN zw_advice_image i ON a.ADVICE_ID = i.ADVICE_ID WHERE a.ADVICE_ID = #{adviceId} GROUP BY a.ADVICE_ID, sr.NAME, rr.NAME, at.CODE_DESC, ast.CODE_DESC, st.CODE_DESC
